passages.text: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song.
David was in a cave.
This is a prayer.
This is a maskil, a song of wisdom.

passages.text: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this prayer.
David was in a cave.
David cried out to the LORD.
David called to the LORD for help.
David asked the LORD for mercy.
passages.original: מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִ֑ד בִּהְיוֹת֖וֹ בַמְּעָרָ֣ה תְפִלָּֽה׃ ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃

passages.text: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
passages.sermon:
David was in a cave.
David prayed to the Lord.
David spoke honestly to God.
David told God about his complaint.
David shared his trouble with God.
David did not hide his feelings from God.
passages.original: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃

passages.text: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is in a cave.
David prays to the LORD.
David feels weak inside.
David’s spirit grows faint.
The LORD knows David’s way.
David walks on a certain path.
Enemies hide a trap for David along this path.
passages.original: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

passages.text: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is alone and in distress.
He asks God to look to his right and see his situation.
No one stands with him.
No one notices him.
He has no place of safety.
No one cares about his life.
He feels abandoned and without help.
passages.original: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין׀ וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־ לִ֪י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David cries out to God.
David says, “You are my refuge.”
David says, “You are my portion in the land of the living.”
passages.original: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃

passages.text: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David feels weak and helpless.
David cries out to God.
David says, "Listen to my cry."
David says, "I am very low."
David asks God, "Rescue me from my pursuers."
David says, "My pursuers are too strong for me."
passages.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀ אֶֽל־ רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־ דַלּ֪וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the Lord.
David asks God to free his soul from prison.
David wants to praise God's name.
David says the righteous will gather around him.
David says God will show him goodness.
passages.original: ה֘וֹצִ֤יאָה מִמַּסְגֵּ֨ר׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְהוֹד֪וֹת אֶת־ שְׁ֫מֶ֥ךָ בִּ֭י יַכְתִּ֣רוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים כִּ֖י תִגְמֹ֣ל עָלָֽי׃
